items.quote: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
items.claim: The text (6:1) says the LORD told Moses he would act against Pharaoh. Because of that action, Pharaoh would be forced to let the people go and would drive them out of his land.
items.action: declares what he will do to Pharaoh; Pharaoh will let them go and drive them out
items.object: Pharaoh; 'them' (the people, not named in this verse)
items.place: Pharaoh's land (the verse does not name it)
